protocol:
1. Set up the bench with a green ice bucket containing labeled microcentrifuge/PCR tubes, tube racks, pipette-tip boxes, a blue 96-well tube rack, and an adjustable single-channel micropipette; keep the labeled tubes chilled on ice.

2. Using the adjustable micropipette, aspirate clear liquid from a source tube or well in the blue 96-well rack; the pipette volume setting is not readable.

3. Dispense the clear liquid into a labeled chilled microcentrifuge/PCR tube held open at the bench.

4. Repeat the liquid transfer for additional labeled chilled tubes, returning tubes to the ice bucket between handling steps.

5. Close the prepared tube caps by hand and place the capped tubes in a tube rack.

6. Load the capped tubes into a benchtop mini-centrifuge with a blue rotor and spin briefly to collect liquid at the bottom of the tubes; the spin time and speed are not displayed.

7. Remove the spun tubes and transport the prepared sample tube(s) to the thermal-cycler station.

8. Open the Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler and load the prepared PCR tube(s) or tube strip/plate into the thermal-cycler block.

9. Close the heated lid of the Bio-Rad T100 Thermal Cycler.

10. Select and start the stored thermal-cycler program on the T100 touchscreen; a multi-step temperature profile is displayed, but the exact temperatures and times are not readable.
